key_findings: Etanercept attenuated ACLT-induced OA, synovitis and nociception in rats, increasing HDAC4 and reducing HDAC6, HDAC7, RUNX2 and MMP13 in cartilage.
Chondroprotection may involve HDAC4/6/7 modulation repressing RUNX2 and MMP13.
